meta.title: Skill Picker
meta.description: Browses the host skill catalog by lifecycle phase, searches in Chinese or English, inserts the picked skills as /name, and installs new ones from a repo, URL, pasted SKILL.md, or the skills.sh registry. / 按开发阶段浏览技能目录，用中文或英文搜索，把选中的技能以 /name 插入输入框，并能在面板内安装新技能。

catalog.failed: Catalog unavailable; showing the built-in list
catalog.fallback: The host returned no skills; showing the built-in list

installed.empty: Nothing installed yet. Use the Add tab.
